categories.title: Ordering
categories.description: Placing an order, changing it, and what happens right after checkout.

faqs.question: Do I need an account to order?
faqs.answer: No. Checkout is guest-only by design — you enter your name, phone, governorate and address, and we identify the order by the short code we issue you. Fewer details stored means less to lose.

faqs.question: What is my order code and where do I find it?
faqs.answer: It is the short uppercase code shown on the confirmation screen and in the WhatsApp message we send. It identifies your order everywhere: tracking, confirmation, returns and support.

faqs.question: Can I change or cancel my order after placing it?
faqs.answer: Yes, until the order is packed. Message us with your order code and what you want changed. Once the parcel is with the courier we can no longer alter or recall it.

faqs.question: An item went out of stock after I ordered it.
faqs.answer: Stock is reserved for you the moment you place the order, so this is rare. If it does happen we contact you within the same day and offer an equivalent item or a full refund — your choice.

faqs.question: Can I order by WhatsApp instead of the website?
faqs.answer: You can. Send us the product links and your delivery details and we will place the order for you and send back the order code. The prices and policies are identical either way.

categories.title: Payment
categories.description: Cash on delivery, and how your order is confirmed.

faqs.question: How do I pay for my order?
faqs.answer: In cash, to the courier, when your order arrives. After checkout you receive your order code on WhatsApp, and our team contacts you there to confirm the order before it ships.

faqs.question: How long does it take to confirm my order?
faqs.answer: Usually under two hours during opening hours. Orders placed late at night are confirmed the next morning. Your tracking page moves to confirmed as soon as it is done.

faqs.question: What happens if you cannot reach me to confirm?
faqs.answer: Your order stays open for 24 hours while we try to confirm it. After that it is automatically marked as expired. You can still message us — if the items are still available we will reinstate the order.

faqs.question: Is cash on delivery available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every order is cash on delivery — you pay the courier when the parcel reaches you.

faqs.question: I placed my order but the status has not changed.
faqs.answer: Our team confirms every order on WhatsApp. If you have not heard from us within a couple of hours during opening hours, reply on the same WhatsApp thread with your order code and we will follow up.

categories.title: Delivery
categories.description: Timelines, coverage, and what to do on delivery day.

faqs.question: How long will my order take to arrive?
faqs.answer: One to two working days for Greater Cairo, two to three for Alexandria and the Delta, and three to four for Canal, Sinai, Upper Egypt and the frontier governorates. The count starts when your order is confirmed.

faqs.question: How much is shipping to my governorate?
faqs.answer: Rates start from 60 EGP, vary by governorate and are charged once per order. The full live table is on the shipping information page, and the exact fee is shown at checkout before you confirm.

faqs.question: Can I open the parcel before paying the courier?
faqs.answer: Inspect the parcel while the courier is present, before you hand over the cash. Refusing a damaged item there and then is much simpler than claiming afterwards.

faqs.question: Nobody was home when the courier came.
faqs.answer: Couriers attempt delivery twice. If the second attempt also fails the parcel returns to us and your order is marked as returned to origin. Message us and we will arrange a redelivery or refund you.

faqs.question: Do you ship outside Egypt?
faqs.answer: Not yet. We currently deliver only to the Egyptian governorates listed on the shipping information page.

categories.title: Returns & warranty
categories.description: Sending something back, refunds, and faults after the return window.

faqs.question: How long do I have to return something?
faqs.answer: Fourteen days from delivery, with the item complete in its original packaging. Damaged, incomplete or incorrect items should be reported within 48 hours.

faqs.question: How do I start a return?
faqs.answer: Message us on WhatsApp with your order code and what is wrong, plus a photo if the item is damaged or faulty. We confirm eligibility within 24 hours and arrange a pickup from your address.

faqs.question: When will I get my money back?
faqs.answer: Within five working days of the returned item reaching us and passing inspection. Store credit is the fastest option — it is issued within 24 hours.

faqs.question: My item stopped working after the return window.
faqs.answer: That falls under the manufacturer warranty rather than the return policy. Send us your order code and a description of the fault and we will open the claim with the service centre on your behalf.

categories.title: Privacy & security
categories.description: What we hold, who can see it, and how your order stays yours.

faqs.question: What details do you store about me?
faqs.answer: Only what an order needs: your name, phone number, delivery address and governorate, plus the order itself. There are no customer accounts and no passwords to lose.

faqs.question: Can someone else look up my order with just the code?
faqs.answer: No. The tracking page also requires the last four digits of the phone number used at checkout, and a wrong phone number returns the same response as a code that does not exist.

faqs.question: Will you message me about offers?
faqs.answer: Only if you sign up for the newsletter. Order-related messages are transactional — you will get those because you ordered, not because you subscribed.
